
gpu/gpu-dma-rdpoll
P bs poll, four times (cycles, from CHCR2's store to the poll's end; Timer 2 at the system clock / 8) and the poll's turns, of a
2,048-word read of 64x64 at (0,256) by DMA2, the display off. Polls: 0 CHCR2 alone, 1 + a Timer 2 read, 2 + a RAM store, 3 + a
scratchpad store, 4 + a Timer 2 read and two RAM stores, 5 + 40 nops. No assertions.
